This petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 482 Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023, for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in case FIR No.0079 dated 30.06.2024 under Sections 406, 420 IPC and Section 13 of Punjab Travel Professions (Regulation) Act 2014 (Sections 465, 468, 471 of IPC added later on vide Rapat No.28 dated 12.08.2024 and Section) registered at Police Station Nakodar Sadar, District Jalandhar Rural.

entities.text: Police Station Nakodar Sadar, District Jalandhar Rural
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner is not willing to comply with the previous order dated 06.09.2024 whereby he volunteered to pay Rs.26,40,000/- as was credited to his account.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has changed his version today for extending the condition that he is ready to pay the amount as offered on the last date of hearing subject to respondent-complainant agreeing to facilitate quashing of the FIR against him.

The petitioner is not willing to accede to such concession of condition submitting that a total of Rs.48 lakhs was paid by him and major part of that is in cash for which he claims to have a video in which brother of the petitioner can be seen receiving some cash amount.

He also asserts to have other material to produce in support of his assertion and Balraj Singh vs State Of Punjab on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171286060/

sentences.text: therefore quashing of FIR would not arise at this stage.

In the light of above, having heard both the parties, on the previous date of hearing itself this Court does not deemed the present petition appropriate for accepting wherein respondent-complainant has been denied of his hard earned money to the tune of Rs.48 lakhs on account of sending abroad but neither the money is being repaid nor the promise made by the petitioner and his brother has been fulfilled.

In the light of above, the petition being devoid of any merit is dismissed, particularly considering the aspect that petitioner has failed to adhere before this Court qua his own undertaking tendered on the last date of hearing.
